cues: A formal email is a letter with the envelope printed on top.
The header does the work of the addresses, so you don't repeat them.
To: one reader, the person who can actually decide.
Cc: people who need to know but need not act.
The subject: six to ten words naming the action, request to hold a blood donation camp on the fifteenth of Magh, never just hello sir.
Mention any attachment in the body.
And below the header, stay as formal as a letter.
